name: Tiny Comet
blurb: Tiny Comet brought us on after seeing our earlier games. We built Nation Survival for them — a 1600s Jamestown survival game — and came out of it with a much stronger grip on game design and hard technical problems.

name: Altera
tag: WE BUILT FOR THEM · ACQUIRED LIAR'S GAME
blurb: We built AI Friendzone RP for Altera (now Fundamental Research Labs). Separately, our social deduction game Liar's Game grew past 2K concurrent players — Altera acquired it and we relaunched it as Truths Table, with AI agents that play and chat alongside you.
